visualCharacteristics: Two-column intro banner on a light background: heading, subheading and two CTA buttons on the left; a collage of three images on the right (one wide image on top, two smaller images below).
contentPattern: Row 1: heading + subheading + CTA links. Following rows: images that form the collage.
usage: High-impact page intro (hero) pairing a headline and calls-to-action with a cluster of lifestyle images.
